# Dotcode ERP by Dotcode Solutions
> Easy accounting software for consulting and service firms: client invoicing, retainers, expenses, project profitability and reports. One-time license, setup and training included.

## Product
- [Dotcode ERP overview](https://dotcodesolutions.com/): What Dotcode ERP does, who it is for, and how to get started
- [Pricing](https://dotcodesolutions.com/pricing): Online $850 one-time + $40/month hosting (unlimited users); Offline $1,200 one-time (1 user)
- [Setup, data transfer and training](https://dotcodesolutions.com/implementation): How we set you up and train your team
- [Custom software](https://dotcodesolutions.com/custom-software): Custom business software built around your processes

## Features
- [All features](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features)
- [Client invoicing](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/client-invoicing): Branded invoices with your terms and payment details
- [Time and fee billing](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/time-and-fee-billing): Hourly, fixed-fee, milestone and retainer billing
- [Recurring billing](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/recurring-billing): Retainers, support contracts and subscriptions that invoice themselves
- [Client balances](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/client-balances): Running client balances, overdue alerts and aging
- [Expense tracking](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/expense-tracking): Expenses by category and by project
- [Project profitability](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/project-profitability): Revenue against cost for each client, matter or project
- [Cash and bank](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/cash-and-bank): Every bank account and cash balance in one view
- [Vendor bills](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/vendor-bills): Bills from contractors, landlords and software vendors
- [Reports](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/reports): Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow and aging
- [Multi-office](https://dotcodesolutions.com/features/multi-office): Per-office and firm-wide revenue, costs and cash

## Who it's for
- [All industries](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for): Accounting for firms that sell expertise
- [Consulting firms](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/consulting-firms): Engagements, retainers and client margins
- [Law firms](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/law-firms): Billing by client and matter, fees and disbursements
- [Tech and software companies](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/tech-and-software-companies): Projects, support contracts and subscriptions
- [IT services and managed service providers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/it-services-and-managed-service-providers): Recurring contracts billed automatically
- [Marketing, design and creative agencies](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/marketing-and-creative-agencies): Retainers, project fees and client margins
- [Accounting, audit and tax practices](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/accounting-audit-and-tax-practices): Engagement billing and your own firm's books
- [Architects and engineering firms](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/architects-and-engineering-firms): Milestone billing and project costs
- [Recruitment and staffing agencies](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/recruitment-and-staffing-agencies): Placement fees and contractor billing
- [Training, coaching and education providers](https://dotcodesolutions.com/who-its-for/training-coaching-and-education-providers): Course fees in, costs out
